Baseline Engine runtime separates tokenizer/main process, scheduler subprocess, and detokenizer subprocess; alternate layouts are selected explicitly.
Startup resolves and validates arguments before publishing context; failures restore prior context and selected partial-initialization paths clean created workers/transports.
Default loader delegates named weights to model.load_weights; bypass loaders must preserve model post-load fixup requirements.
Qwen2 loading maps separate q/k/v projection checkpoint names into packed qkv_proj with shard identities.
Frontend creates per-request state before tokenization, distinguishing undelivered cleanup from dispatched scheduler abort.
Incremental response draining coalesces queued deltas to preserve token IDs while cumulative output has different semantics.
NextBatchPlan separates maintained running state from current execution batch; chunked requests are excluded from premature prefill-to-decode merge.
Radix matching includes namespaces/salt and page alignment; matching can split nodes and clone index slices without copying underlying attention payloads.
Lock-reference zero/nonzero transitions transfer segment counts between evictable and protected accounting while walking shared ancestors.
ReqToTokenPool reserves row zero for padding, reuses rows with monotonic generation counters, and distinguishes request rows from KV locations.
Paged allocation and free_segment operate with page boundaries; grouped/staged frees need retained page representatives and duplicate-release safety.
Overlap loop fences shared reads, retains batch snapshots/results, and processes prior results before dependent current sampling.
Ordinary decode preparation allocates output locations and creates new length tensors to avoid racing queued overlap references.
TpModelWorker converts ScheduleBatch into ForwardBatch, with optional adjusted replay work before ModelRunner execution.
SamplingBatchInfo filtering updates row-specific tensors and state to preserve request sampling semantics through batch changes.
DPBudget skips unchanged timestamp snapshots and tracks request/token estimates separately for selected placement policies.
Trailing auxiliary pools can have nonmonotonic restorable boundary sets; callers intersect rank-local compatible boundaries instead of reducing only maxima.
KVPoll distinguishes bootstrap/input/transfer/success/failure; KVArgs carries model state layout and auxiliary components.
Staging ring assignment overcommits across rounds; remote writer safety depends on watermark/round protocol before RDMA.
Pool accounting checks available+evictable+protected+session-held+uncached against total, supplemented by alignment and ownership checks.
